issues.description: All setting-specific Raw_*_Data.dta files are absent. The authors omitted the Form ADV–TASS merge program and its manual name adjustments; exact field/date classification and delivered-panel compatibility are unresolved. The three packaged DTA files are identifier lists only.

Each controls program actively merges a setting-specific precomputed CV_sadka file, while the accompanying statsby/transform recipe is block-commented after that merge. Its variablepermanent source and exact output contract are unresolved; the recipe references beta_cons without a visible _stat_1 rename. A compatible prepared CV_sadka file can bypass the recipe.

Each controls program actively merges a setting-specific CV_audit_*.dta. No producer is supplied; the source says the control depends on historical audit data outside the standard WRDS download. The required historical month counts and compatibility route remain unresolved.

Each of the four cookie-jar programs contains a commented statsby/transform block for its setting-specific *_adjdecember file, then actively merges that file. The package has no compatible prepared sidecars; activate the supplied block as a preparation step or supply compatible prepared inputs.

The datasheet explicitly says the HF treatment field NEW may be named reg2006. HF_Controls and HF_KinkFlags preserve reg2006 while PSM_HF and earlier logged analysis consume NEW. Table8 later constructs NEW from reg2006 in its own branch, which does not establish an earlier alias. At the HF handoff, retain reg2006 and materialize the documented NEW alias only after checking that NEW is absent or consistent and the values match the datasheet definition; do not rename globally.

PSM_DF consumes DF_FLAGS plus DF_Controls and then refers to the exact fields ERA and previous_registrant. The supplied cookie-jar and kink producers explicitly keep only productreference/post/adj_dec and productreference/post/abn_kink/NEW, respectively; the controls collapse does not output ERA or previous_registrant. ERA is listed in the raw-panel notes, but previous_registrant has no specified source. A compatible externally prepared DF_FLAGS or DF_Controls could carry these exact fields; check those inputs and preserve the names without inferring aliases.

The three-period kink program collapses total_obs without generating it in that program. The raw-panel description does not list total_obs, but the actual prepared raw input could supply it; its producer, meaning and period denominator remain unknown. Clarify the intended field and any count restriction; do not manufacture a constant or transfer the other settings’ 30-month rule.

The log's Table1–Table8 command blocks are substantive analysis code, but the first command invokes an external $path/Code/Tables/Table1 tree and the package contains no standalone analysis driver or initialized $path. Extract/assemble a complete driver while preserving all logged branches.

The preparation sources contain redacted [redacted-path-e6338825a968]... paths, and the log expects a project-root $path. Selecting the host working directory and making these paths coherent is routine run configuration; the package still needs a complete driver and compatible inputs before execution.

Tables 4–8 consume separate TASS/ADV sidecars (audit/provider history, custody, red flags, DF_ADV and fund-death/append panels) not included in this package. Their direct input field and period contracts require validation from the log; no data acquisition or producer is supplied.

Table8 winsorizes rateofreturn on each entire FundDeath+Append input before restricting dates, and its lag6 construction reads L2–L7 plus previous-month NAV/return. Exact full-input population/history and at least seven prior monthly observations for the first event month must be preserved/validated; 60-month target windows alone do not establish it.

evidence.quote:
TABLE S12: Test Extending the Original Timeframe of 60 Months to 120 Months

    Table S12 examines the effect of SEC regulation on misreporting using the four‐period
event window. All models are run using OLS, and the dependent variable is the number of
misreporting flags. Panel A presents the joint analysis of the Hedge Fund Rule and Goldstein

validation: Check merge-key uniqueness and field types for each sidecar against its corresponding prepared control panel; compare historical audit-month and Sadka-control coverage to the author specification.

Confirm a valid Datastream route for S&PCOMP(RI) and FRUSS2L(RI), including monthly history and entitlement; map its index mnemonics to equity and sizespread without substituting another factor.
validation: Before merging, confirm each factor source has unique year/month keys, expected monthly periods, units and target columns, and that the four merges retain the author samples.

steps: Obtain the author-described sidecars or the exact generation recipe for each; use the public SEC archive for Form ADV based construction where applicable, and do not assume that similarly named TASS tables have the historical status fields.
Validate the exact keys and fields read in each Table4–8 branch, including date alignment for monthly audit/provider histories, custody, red-flag components, Q5f2c AUM and mainofficecountry.

For Table8, retain both FundDeath and Append inputs and the full population/history used by winsorization; retain at least the prior seven month positions needed by L2–L7 at each event-window start, plus the prior month NAV/return for flows.
validation: Check each file's format, columns, keys, expected populations and periods; verify event-window filters and pre-event lag coverage against the logged code before an authorized run.
